name: Live Activity
description: A progress Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island (for orders, trips or timers), started, updated and ended from the app.

cost.note: Apple frameworks only; server-driven updates need push notifications and a backend

usage: Hold one `LiveActivityController` (it is `@Observable`) at the composition root, inject it as `any LiveActivityControlling`. Call `start(title:subtitle:steps:)` with the step names (for example Placed, Preparing, On the way, Delivered), `advance(to:eta:)` as the step changes, and `end()` when done. Rename `ProgressActivityAttributes` fields to fit the app. Updates are local; remote updates need push notifications.
statusNote: Not yet built on a Mac; run `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify live-activity` on a Mac with Xcode.
